title: mPOS, UPRam, mitoCPR, DELE1-HRI and Import-Stress Signaling Atlas
prior: v400 mtHsp70/PAM, OMA1-DNAJC15 and proteostasis import control

primary_sources.finding: Defined mitochondrial precursor over-accumulation stress (mPOS) and a cytosolic anti-degenerative network.
Mistargeted mitochondrial precursors trigger UPRam, lowering protein synthesis and increasing proteasomal activity.
mitoCPR induces Cis1; Cis1 recruits Msp1/proteasomal clearance to stalled precursors at mitochondrial translocases.
OMA1 cleavage of DELE1 releases cytosolic DELE1, activates HRI, eIF2alpha phosphorylation and ATF4.
Independent genetic identification of OMA1-DELE1-HRI as a mitochondrial-to-cytosol ISR relay.

primary_sources.authors: Fessler E, Krumwiede L, Jae LT
primary_sources.finding: DELE1 senses multiple import/processing defects; OMM import defects can activate HRI via full-length DELE1 without OMA1 cleavage.
Iron limitation arrests DELE1 import, stabilizes DELE1 at the mitochondrial surface, activates HRI-ISR; imported DELE1 is normally degraded by LONP1.

equations: dP_cyt/dt = J_syn,mito - J_import - J_extract - k_deg P_cyt
Phi_import = J_syn,mito / (J_import + J_extract + k_deg P_cyt + epsilon)
dCis1/dt = alpha_C S_import - k_C Cis1 ; J_extract = k_Msp1 Cis1 P_stall
dD_cyt/dt = k_OMA1 A_OMA1 D_transit + k_arrest D_surface - k_clear D_cyt
J_translation = J0 T(p_eIF2a), with dT/dp_eIF2a < 0 for bulk translation
evidence_boundary: Yeast mPOS/UPRam/mitoCPR and mammalian OMA1-DELE1-HRI are not treated as a single conserved molecular pathway. Equations are transparent synthesis models unless explicitly identified as canonical biochemical relations.
